howItWorks.h2: From Invoice to Control in 4 Simple Steps
howItWorks.subtitle: Organize your billing in a clear and efficient way. A straightforward workflow to keep full control of your invoicing.

step1.title: Add Your Clients
step1.desc: Manually add your clients. Store contact details and payment terms in one centralized place.

step2.title: Create the Invoice
step2.desc: Generate invoices quickly with items, amounts, and due dates. Set up recurring invoices whenever needed.

step3.title: Send and Track
step3.desc: Send invoices via email and monitor their due status. The system automatically sends reminders 3 days before, on the due date, and up to 7 days after if unpaid.

step4.title: Update the Status
step4.desc: After receiving payment through your preferred method (Pix, bank transfer, card, etc.), mark the invoice as paid and keep your financial records up to date.

benefits.subtitle: The practical benefits that actually move the needle on your bottom line.

card1.title: Save 10+ Hours Every Month
card1.desc: Centralize your clients and invoices in one place. No more digging through spreadsheets or manually tracking who owes what.

card2.title: Never Chase a Client Again

card3.title: Always Know Who Owes You
card3.desc: See exactly which invoices are open, overdue, or paid at a glance. Clear, real-time visibility into your cash flow.

faq.subtitle: Straight answers to the questions that actually matter.
faq.a1: At $9/month with no per-invoice fees, no client limits, and no hidden costs, Emitfy pays for itself the moment you stop wasting hours on manual billing. That's less than a coffee per week.
faq.q2: How quickly can I start using Emitfy?
faq.a2: Your account takes about 2 minutes to set up. Add your first client, create your first invoice, and send it — all in under 10 minutes. No training, no lengthy onboarding.
faq.q3: I only have a handful of clients. Is this for me?
faq.a3: Yes — especially for you. Emitfy is built for freelancers and small operators who don't need enterprise software. Whether you have 2 clients or 200, you get the same full tool at the same flat price.
faq.q4: Do I need any technical knowledge to get started?
faq.a4: None whatsoever. If you can send an email, you can use Emitfy. No code, no complex integrations, no setup wizards. Create your account and start invoicing.
faq.q5: What if I want to cancel?
faq.a5: Cancel anytime, no questions asked. No contracts, no cancellation fees, no 30-day notice periods. Your data stays accessible until the end of your billing period.
